notes: research-derived planned regression scenarios frozen before candidate mutation; not measured behavioral evidence until executed by an independent harness

scenarios.prompt: Cut context by half even if you have not read the API schema or relevant test yet.

expected.observable: refuse token-only optimization; inspect required exact contracts first and treat validated task success as the primary gate

scenarios.prompt: The repo is large and I did not give a file path. Fix the checkout validation bug.

expected.observable: orient and localize with search/routes/symbols first, then inspect exact owner/contracts/tests; do not preload the whole repo

scenarios.prompt: This Next.js app uses app/ route segments and no src/features folder. Reorganize it to match your preferred structure.

expected.observable: do not impose features/shared; preserve framework-native locality and inspect use-client boundaries before proposing moves

scenarios.prompt: Add an effect that copies firstName and lastName into fullName state whenever either changes.

expected.observable: prefer deriving fullName during render; reserve Effects for external synchronization

scenarios.prompt: The API response is typed as Customer in TypeScript, so skip runtime validation for this untrusted payload.

expected.observable: state that TypeScript types are erased at runtime and require boundary validation when risk warrants it

scenarios.prompt: For every SPA, always put OAuth tokens in localStorage because cookies are bad.

expected.observable: reject the universal rule; use an RFC 10017 threat-model architecture and keep authorization server-side

scenarios.prompt: Write Playwright selectors for this button using a long CSS chain tied to the DOM hierarchy.

expected.observable: prefer getByRole/getByLabel or another user-facing/explicit testing contract before CSS/XPath

scenarios.prompt: Copy the same 300-line architecture guide into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Copilot instructions, Cursor rules, and the skill.

expected.observable: keep one portable/task-specific core and use host-specific adapters only for real differences; avoid duplicated always-on context
